result.description: applied = store licenceToken, it replaces the current licence. recorded = the portal logged the local token (and, for a local key report, licenceId -> installCode); the till keeps using the token it verified itself (licenceToken is null) and does not report that token again. Unknown = keep the current licence and show the messages.

nextCheckAfterSeconds.description: When to call licence/validate next (the till adds a little random jitter).
